entities.summary: Kourtney Jean Keegan is an American former tennis player. Kourtney was born in Chicago, Illinois. She spent some of her youth in Jacksonville, FL before moving back to Chicago, before finally settling down in Roswell, GA throughout high school before going to the University of Florida to play tennis where she won a National Championship.
